text:
marie_support: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 502/504s and timeouts against Hosted Inference in us-west-2, started ~2025-09-12T07:20PT. Errors concentrated around az-2 and cross-zone traffic. Posting customer ticket links in thread.
eli_oncall: Observed a sharp spike in gateway 5xx rate and auth timeouts. Token introspect calls to auth-portal are intermittently timing out (500ms -> 3s+). Traces show requests stuck waiting for upstream auth response.
sanjay_neteng: Network telemetry shows repeated BGP withdraws from a transit peer (ASN 65432) affecting our us-west-2-e egress. Packet loss spikes and increased RTT between az-2 and egress POPs during the incident window.
marie_support: Customer impact: request failures for generation endpoints, some customers seeing billing/charge confusion because retries hit rate limits. They raised P0 for one enterprise account.
maya_platform: Quick repro: curl against production gateway returns 502 with upstream read error.

```
$ curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: redwood-gateway
X-Request-Id: req_01Fxyz
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"upstream read timeout"}
```

eli_oncall: Collected gateway logs around 07:20-07:50 PT. Key pattern: gateway -> auth-introspect downstream timeouts, then gateway returns 502. Example:

```
[gateway] WARN request_id=req_01Fxyz upstream_timeout ms=2500 route=/v1/generate upstream=auth-introspect status=502
```

sanjay_neteng: Ran mtr and tcp traceroutes from az-2 to our auth POPs; we see intermittent packet loss and ECMP path churn. Sample mtr output shows 20% loss at hop 6 (transit peer). I'm opening a ticket with the carrier now.

```
# mtr -r -c 50 auth-pop-usw2
 6. transit-peer.example.net  20.0%  42ms
```

support_lead_alex: Customers want ETA and mitigation. Can we offer a temporary mitigation (fallback region or routing tweak) and a clear message? Also need to confirm if any billing anomalies happened due to retries.

eli_oncall: Mitigation plan enacted:
- Disabled sticky routing for affected customer pools so requests can route to other AZs/regions.
- Increased gateway retry count to 3 with jitter for auth calls.
- Temporarily allowed cross-region fallback for hosted API (eu-west-1) for latency-tolerant customers.
- Filed carrier ticket: TKT-987654 (ASN 65432) and escalated to L2.

marie_support: Noted. Communicated soft mitigation to affected customers and documented steps in the customer ticket. Asking engineering to collect sample traces for billing team.

devops-bot: Deploy started: gateway-config@rollout-802 -> disabling sticky routing and retry update. CI check passed.

maya_platform: After rollout we see 60% reduction in 5xx for affected pools. Still seeing auth timeouts for ~5% of requests — likely due to in-flight sessions still hitting degraded peer.

sanjay_neteng: Carrier responded: "We observed route instability on peer link -> performing flap mitigation. Monitoring BGP session stability." They requested our traceroutes and timestamps (provided).

eli_oncall: Next steps:
- Keep retry/fallback changes in place until carrier confirms stable (monitor for 12 hours).
- Run a rolling canary to revert sticky routing once network stable.
- Postmortem checklist: include timestamps, sample traces, impacted customer list, any billing anomalies (duplicate charges from retries) and mitigation timeline.

marie_support: Can someone own customer billing check? Please ping finance/support.

support_lead_alex: I'll own billing review and coordinate refunds if duplicates found. Also drafting incident update for status.redwood.ai with summary + link to carrier ticket.

customer_jira_bot: Linked customer tickets: JIRA-12345, JIRA-23456. Notified customers of mitigation and asked for any repro logs.

eli_oncall: Logging note: keep full gateway+auth traces for 30 days (increased retention for this incident). Add eval hooks to detect auth-induced 5xx in next week.

sanjay_neteng: Closing carrier loop when they confirm no more withdraws for 3 hours. Will provide final BGP logs and AS path dumps.

marie_support: Thanks team. Filing follow-up items for the postmortem and customer comms. :thumbsup:
